hook: Three apps need the same tools. Why maintain three drifting copies?
bullets: One MCP server exposes narrow Jira and CRM tools
Each app discovers them with tools/list
tools/call reaches Jira with a token from the server's env
Tool results are treated as untrusted data
Fix the tool once and all three apps get it
cta: Watch the flow, then go deeper in the full course:
shows: This short animation shows one MCP server written once and used by three apps.
